summary: The 588023 Compound Lateral Slide uses (2) of the 588020’s
specs: The 588020 Precision Lateral Slide has 2” travel for horizontal alignment to known points
The 588023 allows for a full 2” of travel in X and Y directions
Both have a standard external 3½” x 8 instrument thread mount on top
A dovetail on the bottom seats into the 580800 lift or the 582356 adapter, rotating 360°
title: 588023 Lateral Slides
